children.title: API & Caching
children.sub: TMDB client with two-tier caching, image URL generation, and data normalization.
children.detail: Every TMDB call goes through `api.tmdb()`, which checks an in-memory Map first, then sessionStorage with a 1-hour TTL, then fetches from the network. Concurrent requests for the same URL share one promise.

rows.detail: Read the key; if found and younger than 1 hour, wrap in Promise.resolve and store in Map.

rows.title: Fetch from network
rows.detail: GET with bearer token in Authorization header. On success, store result in both sessionStorage and Map.

rows.title: On failure
rows.detail: Delete the Map entry so the next call retries. sessionStorage is not written.

issues.title: In-memory cache never expires
issues.detail: The Map is checked before sessionStorage's 1-hour TTL. Once a URL is cached in memory, it is served indefinitely until page refresh. During long sessions, trending and discover data goes stale while the user sees no indication.

issues.title: Quota error wipes entire session cache
issues.detail: When sessionStorage.setItem throws a quota error, the catch block removes every cached key, destroying all cached responses, but does not retry the write. The triggering response is only cached in memory and lost on reload.

children.title: API And Caching
children.sub: TMDB client with two-tier caching: in-memory Map and sessionStorage with one-hour TTL.
children.detail: The `tmdb()` function builds a URL from the path and params, checks an in-memory `Map`, then `sessionStorage` (with 1-hour expiry), then fetches with the hardcoded bearer token. On `sessionStorage` quota errors it clears all `sm:*` keys and retries.

rows.title: Build URL
rows.detail: Constructs URL from TMDB base + path, injects language setting as default param.

rows.title: Check in-memory Map
rows.detail: Uses pathname+search as key. Returns cached Promise if found (deduplicates concurrent calls).

rows.title: Check sessionStorage
rows.detail: Reads sm:{key}, parses JSON, checks if timestamp is within one hour. Returns data if fresh.

rows.title: Fetch from TMDB
rows.detail: Sends GET with Authorization: Bearer token. On success, stores in sessionStorage via setCache().

rows.title: Handle quota
rows.detail: If setCache() throws (storage full), clears all sm:* keys from sessionStorage and swallows the error.

AUTHORED.title: Managing Library
AUTHORED.sub: Watchlist, watch history, watched-state toggling, settings persistence, and the list and settings pages

group.note: Five concerns of the same library system: storage, two kinds of write trigger, and the two pages that display or configure it

AUTHORED.detail: All user data — watchlist, play history, and watched-state flags — lives in `localStorage` under three JSON keys. The `SM.library` module reads, writes, and emits events that keep every page in sync.

issues.title: Import accepts malformed data
issues.detail: SM.library.import only checks that e.app equals "heartive". Entries in watchlist or history with missing type or id fields are stored, producing "undefined:undefined" keys that break duplicate detection and card rendering.

issues.title: localStorage writes fail silently
issues.detail: All writes are wrapped in try-catch that swallows errors. If storage is full, toggleList, pushHistory, and setWatched report success and update the UI, but the data is lost on reload.

rows.title: Return or skip
rows.detail: If all three conditions pass, return the lastEp metadata. Otherwise return null — no badge for this show.
